title: A Hard Choice
subtitle: Now each of us must find our own way forward.

trails.title: Whisper of Flowers
trails.description: Honey, tears, and whispers flow from the heart of the flower.

content.text:
[A flower carried on the "wind." From its heart drifts the scent of honey and the soft voice of a woman.]

Prima, Igor, and his Gryphon Legion have rescued the Foundation's support convoy. I need you to stall them for as long as possible—though slowing them down is all that's required.
Don't ask. I never agreed to take part in this operation, and I still oppose the attack on the school. Pointless fighting and bloodshed do no good for the future of arcanists ... But I still have my duty to fulfill. Whatever comes, we must give everything we have to Her cause. That's all—I'm only here to deliver this message. Don't come looking for me. I'll be gone soon.

[The sweet fragrance and the faint voice fade together.]

trails.title: Secret Communication
trails.description: Allies always need a way to communicate in secret.

content.text:
[A quill grows hot without warning. Drawn from a uniform coat pocket and set upon blank paper, it begins to move on its own, leaving lines of scorched writing.]

SPDM is under attack by Manus Vindictae. I'm on my way to assist. The attack came without warning. Amid the Foundation's containment expansion, headquarters is crowded with unfamiliar personnel. I suspect Manus Vindictae's plans run deeper than this. Share any relevant intelligence if you have it. Fewer than three hours remain until the "Storm." Stay cautious.

[As the admiral reads the final word, the quill's glow dims. The writing catches fire along with the paper, consuming it in an instant, leaving not even ash.]

items.text: A Hard Choice

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Help me get Paravyan over here, and remember to keep yourself in my smoke at all times.
They crouch low and drag Paravyan behind cover.
Alchemical smoke flows out from her crucible, obscuring them further, at least temporarily.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Oh no. He doesn't look good.

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: Just leave me. We're doomed. We ... We're all gonna die here.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What are you yammering about! Toughen up, soldier!

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: I don't want to fight anymore. It's all meaningless. The world's ending anyway.

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: The Foundation, Manus Vindictae, wh-whatever. Just leave me be. I can't get back on my feet again.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Come on, all you've got are a few bruises. What happened?

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Make way!
Yermolai rushes over, kicking a black-clothed corpse down the hill along the way.
He kneels and looks Paravyan over.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Wait. His Umbrella's broken.
Head lowered, Yermolai unfastens the buckle at Paravyan's waist and swaps the damaged Umbrella for a new one.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: I knew it.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: He didn't notice the damage to his Umbrella, and now he's infected with the Storm Syndrome.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: There's a few others like him. Look fine on the outside, but their insides are wallowing in total despair.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: It's like the exact opposite of the war craze from before the 1914 "Storm."

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Where did you get another Umbrella?

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: From someone who doesn't need it anymore. Better used on Beagle, I'd say.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: He'll take a while to recover. Just leave him be.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Have we found a way out?

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: No. Arcane Support's still working on it.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I can—

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Listen, soldier. We all have our own duties, you included. You're not an array expert. Doesn't take an arcanist to know that.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Osborn's down, so I'm the ranking officer here. Understood?

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Have you and Beagle completed the mission Osborn gave you?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: We almost did, until he suddenly refused to cooperate.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Can you finish it? How much longer will it take?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Yes, sir. In about three more minutes, before my arcane smoke lifts.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Got it. We'll cover you in the meantime. Let me know when you're ready.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: All set!

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: All units, fall back!
Soldiers stagger back toward their shrinking defensive line.
The Manus disciples follow up with another attack, threatening to overrun their previous positions.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Whoa!
There is a chain explosion of alchemical mines, sending both Lopera and the Manus disciples rolling down the slope.

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: Lopera! Are you alright?
Paravyan, now recovered from the Storm Syndrome, slides down the hill and searches for Lopera through the smoke.
Lopera staggers out of the mud and rises to her feet.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I'm fine. My Umbrella, too. I just still can't control the explosion precisely. How are you holding up?

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: Better now. Sorry I let you down back there, but I'm not afraid anymore. I'll cover you.
More hostiles appear from the dense smoke of the explosion, encroaching on them like a ring of growing shadows.

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: Attack! ㄠ!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: How many of them are there!
She draws her gun and ducks behind cover.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Stay put, Paravyan. They're charging.

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: Copy that. I see them.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Damn it!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Paravyan?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Hmm? What?
All-too-familiar runes radiate along the dirt around her.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: N-No way.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Ugh!
Try as she might to stand up, she's knocked back down.
A cacophony of shouts mixes into sharp bird calls in her ears.
Footsteps draw near.

items.speaker: Voice I
items.text: There's another one over there. I'll go take a look.

items.speaker: Voice II
items.text: Be careful.

items.speaker: Voice I
items.text: Hey. I've got a girl? Lieutenant, you need to see this.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Who's ...?
She rages against her own helplessness.
Lopera scrambles for her revolver, just barely managing to find it on the ground. She breathes out and prepares to make her last stand.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Voice II
items.text: Don't shoot!
She feels herself being pulled into an embrace.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Lopera!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Molly, is that really you?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Hang in there. I'll get you somewhere safe.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: *cough*

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Are you alright, Father?
Igor surveys the battlefield.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Manus Vindictae won't be able to launch another attack for some time.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Ptolemy, we must reach the convoy's commander. Let them know we are not their enemy.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yes, Father.
The chaos following the Gryphon Legion's arrival settles into an uneasy pause. There are more pressing matters at hand.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: The Foundation convoy has calmed down, as you predicted. We've avoided any unnecessary casualties.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: We saved their lives. They have the sense to see that. Who is their commanding officer?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Their commander was killed, Father. The ranking officer is called Yermolai. He seems able enough. It wasn't difficult to persuade him that we were here to help.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: They're from the Foundation's QRF. The Manus ambush nearly wiped them out.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I'll bring their officer here. And Father, Lopera wants to see you.
Ptolemy salutes, turns, and leaves.
Moldir escorts Lopera over to her father.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: You might have an internal injury of some kind from that explosion, Pera. We'll have time to talk, but for now you need to—

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Get away from me.
Lopera turns to face her father.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What are you doing here?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Trying to help.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Our intention was to arrive directly at the Foundation's headquarters. But it seems whatever arcane skills the Manus have employed are interfering with my own.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: You were fortunate. It seems we arrived without a moment to spare.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: And what? You're going to force me to join your assault on the Foundation?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Our goal is to protect the Foundation. Not destroy it.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Huh?
Igor lets the statement rest and moves on.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Do you have enough Equilibrium Umbrellas for everyone?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: We should, as long as our missing vehicles are intact.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Then the answer is no.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: What do you plan to do, Lopera? Draw lots for the remaining devices?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Our orders were to reach the SPDM. They have an immunity area, as long as we can manage to secure the school.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Can you be certain that you will secure the immunity area before the "Storm" arrives?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: There is no choice in the matter. You will come with us to our shelter.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Your shelter?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: I must put my soldiers first.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: We don't have enough Umbrellas for the entire legion. My men risked their lives to follow me here.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What? Are you out of your mind? You mean they're all exposed to the Storm Syndrome right now?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Don't tell me that includes Molly!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: It's alright, Pera. We'll be fine as long as we get back to the shelter before the reversion starts.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: We volunteered for this operation. Please, Pera, we're trying to help you.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: How did you know the Foundation was under attack?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: We have our sources, but the intel came too late. We missed our window.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: We're unable to teleport there, which means there's nothing we can do to reinforce the Foundation. We're out of options, and I have no intention of leaving you here to die.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I won't go.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Lopera, I'll remind you that I'm your acting commander.
He watches Lopera struggling in Moldir's grip, then turns to Igor.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Your deputy said that headquarters couldn't reinforce us. Why is that?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: The situation there is much worse.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Tch. I've had dreams of burning that place down, but not today, not now. What's happened?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: I do not have the time to brief you.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: I am only able to open my gateway once more before the reversion begins. I can take what's left of your squad to safety.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: We will fall back to our shelter. It is the only safe location I can reach without risking Manus interference.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: For now, I have ordered my legion to assist in decoding this array.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: But if we can't break through before the "Storm" arrives, you'll have no choice but to leave with us.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Then we'll be marked as "traitors," wanted by the Foundation. Just like you.
Igor looks out in the direction of the Foundation. He doesn't argue the point.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: I may not be the fondest of them, but I'm not exactly looking to have their guns pointed at me either.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Your complaints can wait. The Manus are preparing another attack.
President's Office
The top floor of Foundation headquarters remains tranquil despite the chaos below.
By the time the tremors of explosions and incantations reach it, they do little more than stir the dust in the president's office.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: May the peace be with us.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Is she here?

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Arcana has been confirmed to be within the Committee Building. Based on the strength of her forces, I estimate she'll reach us within 30 minutes.

items.speaker: President
items.text: How long until reinforcements arrive?

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: The nearest ground units are 90 minutes away. Unfortunately, they'll need to brave the "Storm" to reach us. They're sending whatever troops they can equip with Equilibrium Umbrellas.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: The Flying Witches are also en route. They should arrive soon, but they don't have the numbers to change our situation. And their air advantage won't be of much use indoors.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Grant all personnel at headquarters access to restricted areas and any available weapons. I want everyone armed.

items.speaker: President
items.text: That should buy us another 30 minutes.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Do you believe the Foundation is no longer capable of solving this crisis on its own?
She poses the question despite already knowing the answer.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: What's the Timekeeper's status?

items.speaker: President
items.text: We can't reach her. We lost communication with the SPDM over an hour ago.
Several doves, almost ethereal in their luster, perch calmly on the edge of the president's desk.
He picks one up and strokes it.

items.speaker: President
items.text: How long until the Pax House responds?

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Soon.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: The Philosopher King is aware of her arrival.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Then that's all we need.
The president holds the dove to the window.

items.speaker: President
items.text: May the peace be with us.
